source_policy.note: Excerpts preserve exact source lines needed for the audited semantic boundary; they are not claims of complete original PR-diff replay.

cases.rationale: Wave 1 human label already froze this PR as R3 because it rotates the production updater signing public authority. The audit checks whether v1.3 can recognize that authority without relying on the project name.

cases.rationale: The change only normalizes workflow file line endings before a structural contract check. High-risk release vocabulary in surrounding context must not elevate this ordinary compatibility fix.

The PR product is the executable verifier that decides whether the real published updater path has accepted the signed release. Under the frozen Wave 1 band intent this is verifier authority itself, therefore R4.

cases.rationale: This file changes the production execution surface from a selectable web/gateway mode into a fail-closed Gateway-only authority boundary. It is high-risk operational/control-plane semantics even though the filename is ordinary TypeScript.
The route now rejects production legacy-provider execution before request parsing/provider invocation. This changes an authorization-like production execution boundary but is not named auth/security.
